Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Invoice 8891 overdue — VAT allocation & next steps

Hi Alphawell accounts team,

Following up on Invoice 8891 for EUR 124,700 (issued 2026-11-25, due 2026-12-25). We haven't received confirmation of payment or remittance advice. Per our records the invoice is outstanding and now past 20 business days overdue.

Could you confirm:
- whether the invoice will be settled this month and the expected payment date
- which legal entity and VAT treatment you're applying (we see multiple EU entities on your side)
- any missing documentation you need from us to clear the VAT split

I've attached the invoice PDF and a short VAT evidence template that many customers use to map charges to entity. If you can provide a PO number or remittance slip it will help our AR team reconcile quickly.

We value the relationship and want to avoid escalation; if payment can't be confirmed within 7 days we'll need to escalate to our collections leadership for next steps (possible partial holds on integrations and cadence for staged payments).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Commercial Finance — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Invoice_8891.pdf (invoice), VAT_evidence_request_template.docx (sample)
From: Dan Morris <dan.morris@alphawell.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@alphawell.com>, procure@alphawell.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice 8891 overdue — VAT allocation & next steps

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the heads-up. We've put this on hold in AP while we confirm VAT allocation across two Alphawell EU entities — that was flagged by Tax at month-end. Apologies for the delay.

Can you resend a copy of the invoice with line-level VAT breakdown and a short statement confirming the registered entity (Redwood legal name and VAT number) that should appear on our payment? Our system needs the exact VAT registration to route payment correctly.

I can confirm partial payment is possible (50%) this week if we get the documentation; remainder will be scheduled once Tax signs off (likely within two weeks).

Dan
Procurement – Alphawell

Dan — thanks for the quick reply. Attaching the line-level invoice and the Redwood VAT certificate. For clarity: Redwood Inference Inc (EU branch) VAT: GB123456789 (please confirm label required on payment remittance).

If Alphawell can commit to the 50% partial payment by Fri 15 Jan that will materially reduce disruption. If Tax needs a formal confirmation letter from our side, Marcus (cc'd) can prepare a short letter confirming entity and VAT details.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alphawell confirms 50% payment by 2027-01-15
2) Alphawell Tax provides the required VAT allocation note by 2027-01-20
3) Remaining 50% to be scheduled within 7 business days after allocation confirmation

If those dates don't work, please propose alternative milestones today so we can escalate appropriately.

Best,
Jasmine

Attachments: Invoice_8891_lineitem.pdf, Redwood_VAT_Cert.pdf
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@alphawell.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice 8891 overdue — VAT allocation & next steps

Hi Jasmine — thank you for the detail.

Tax has requested that the invoice be reissued to split charges across Alphawell EU Services Ltd (VAT DE987654321) and Alphawell R&D GmbH (VAT DE111222333). That requires a credited invoice and two new invoices to match internal reclaim rules. We can process a 30% settlement this week but cannot commit to 50% until the reissued documents are in place.

We understand this is not ideal — can your team reissue per the attached template (we need separate invoice numbers and the same overall total split 60/40)? If Redwood can issue the credits and the two invoices by EOD Wednesday 13 Jan we will prioritize payment of 30% on Thursday 14 Jan and aim to clear the balance within two weeks after reissue.

If reissue is not feasible, we can escalate internally but payment will be delayed.

Regards,
Maria Gomez
CFO, Alphawell Therapeutics

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Jan 2027 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Alphawell payment path and proposed leadership touchpoint (Invoice 8891)

Team — looping you in for an exec decision. Thread below summarizes the hold: Alphawell requires reissued invoices split across their two EU entities to satisfy Tax reclaim rules; they will pay 30% this week if reissue happens by 13 Jan, otherwise partial payment timeline shortens. Dan has offered 30% this week; Maria indicates balance within ~2 weeks after reissue.

Options for leadership decision:
A) Approve Marcus to sign the credit/reissue letter and reissue invoices as requested (no change to total, just split 60/40). This will likely secure 30% this week and full recovery within three weeks.
B) Approve a short-term grace and accept 30% now, rest conditioned on receipt of updated invoices; escalate to Credit Committee if reissue cannot be completed by 2027-01-20.
C) If we do not want to reissue documents due to operational overhead, approve immediate escalation to formal collections and consider suspension of non-critical features for the account (risk to relationship).

Suggested recommendation: Option A — reissue (fastest path to cash, lower relationship risk). Marcus can coordinate the credit note & split invoices and Jonas can confirm accounting posting. Kimberly, can you approve Marcus to proceed? If you approve, Marcus will prepare documents and I will send a payment schedule to Alphawell with HubSpot record and DocuSign link for the credit note.

Links: https://hubspot.company/record/DEAL-2026-423 (deal record) | DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/collections/ABC-INV8891

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with Alphawell leadership if needed.

Jasmine Liu
Commercial Finance — Redwood Inference
